name: The Last Antique Store
source:
After several jobless months, you decide it’s time to look for work. Your search leads you to an unsettling website: an antique store seeking staff for five nights. The pay is attractive, so you take the offer.

[From [url=https://petky.itch.io/the-last-antique-store]Itch.io[/url]]
